dropIn: Replace path/file to swap art. Keep asset_id, slot, anchor, subject_id, and rarity stable. Move buildings by editing hotspot. Move card layers by editing cardLayout.anchors. See docs/ui/ASSET_DROP_IN.md.

referenceOnly.note: Owner-approved full-card PNGs are reference art on core/v05-design-source. They are NOT registered here and must not be used as a card face.

dreamDrop.note: APPROVED reference only. Not copied into web/ and not used as card faces.

hotspot.label: Shopping Mall
hotspot.fitNote: PROPOSED fit. Dream's 330px box crossed the top of the master by 50px. Width is 280 so the sprite box meets y=0. The anchor stays on the proposed pad.

assets.note: Alternate only. Mira bg_battle_arena_v01 stays the default bg-battle.

frameInsets.note: Per-frame transparent windows measured from each rarity PNG. Borders are not interchangeable.

mapPlacement.note: Each proposed x,y is the near/front edge of the empty stone pad, intended to receive the transparent building image bottom-center (CSS translate(-50%, -100%)). Tweak size/anchor only after viewing all building sprites overlaid together. Do not bake buildings into the background.

artDrop.note: Optimized derivatives for review. The official asset status enum has no GENERATED_REVIEW value yet, so status stays CONCEPT (not production) and review_status is GENERATED_REVIEW. Reference-card PNGs are not registered.

battleTiles.note: Feet sit on baked tile centres in bg_battle_arena_v01. Cyan is the left 2x5, magenta the right 2x5. Four of the ten tiles per side are used so the bodies do not share a column. Visual only, not a movement grid.
